scope: Actual assigned portfolios, self-reported contacts/visits and one-use merchant-authorized RFQs; no proof of external calls/physical attendance or native execution.
checks: commercial staff sign in with individual accounts without wholesale, warehouse or team administration powers
only an eligible assigned adviser obtains the primary shop portfolio
portfolio versions, role boundaries and foreign-shop isolation fail closed
contact completion retains the actual author, outcome and next action and creates a bounded follow-up
a future visit cannot be reported complete before its window; a rescheduled visit records self-reported attendance
reasoned cancellation preserves tasks and direct contact reports remain separate records
the shop authorizes only its current named adviser, bounded expiry and its own address
assistance creates only the exact authorized RFQ under the actual adviser identity
the assisted RFQ neither clears the personal basket nor reserves physical stock
same-key replay returns the existing request; a different use cannot create another order
the normal shared price engine produces a quote that still requires the shop own acceptance
unused authorization revocation immediately prevents the adviser from submitting it
an address changed after consent cannot be substituted into the authorized RFQ
reassignment removes the former adviser scope and never transfers an old named authorization
only owner or manager may authorize, and a manager authority change invalidates pending delegated requests
concurrent use of a one-use mandate commits exactly one RFQ
suspending the primary shop blocks pending assistance even for an otherwise active adviser
assistance inherits the primary guest invitation lifetime and live revocation
CRM keeps completed/cancelled tasks, immutable contacts and actual-actor audit events
